email-confirmation.subject: Confirm your email address for {clubName}
email-confirmation.text:
An email address was added to a SocAlytics account for {clubName}.

To confirm it, open this link:
{link}

The link is valid for {lifetime} and can be used once.

If you do nothing, nothing happens. You can ignore this message.

password-recovery.subject: Reset your SocAlytics password
password-recovery.text:
A password reset was requested for a SocAlytics account that uses this email address.

To choose a new password, open this link:
{link}

The link is valid for {lifetime} and can be used once.

If you did not request this, ignore this message. Your password stays unchanged.
